# northflank_team (Data Source)

Looks up a Northflank team by name. Use the resulting `id` to scope project lookups in multi-team configurations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_team" "main" {
  name = "Acme Engineering"
}

output "team_id" {
  value = data.northflank_team.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the team to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `id` (String) Team identifier.
